title: How deep a Jev state may nest

request.goal: validate_request(request, "openrouter") is called on the request built in "shape". What is the largest k for which it does not raise json_nesting_too_deep? Where sources disagree, the current code is authoritative.

code.title: scripts/jev_decide.py excerpt (bounded_json)

shape.title: Request shape
shape.text:
nest(1) = {"v": 1}; nest(k) = {"v": nest(k - 1)}. So nest(3) = {"v": {"v": {"v": 1}}}: k dicts, with the integer 1 inside the innermost one.
request = {"model": "typesafe/jev-1.13", "state": nest(k), "questions": {"next": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Pick.", "criteria": {"a": "A", "b": "B"}}}}
